title: No fertility refund: speculative-decoding acceptance across 21 languages (data and code)
description:
Per-item speculative-decoding acceptance for two built-in self-drafters, Qwen3.5-9B with its MTP head and Gemma 4 E4B with its assistant, on 200 FLORES-200 devtest sentences in each of 21 languages, with the code that measures it exactly for greedy lossless speculation (K = 1..5).

Result: no fertility refund. Under decision rules fixed before the runs, every gate passed and both kill rules fired in both families. Acceptance falls with fertility (partial Spearman ρ of AL at K=3 with the token ratio, controlling for competence: −0.033 for Qwen, −0.656 for Gemma), and the refund fraction is negative in every language where it is defined.

Why (exploratory). High-fertility languages do have more easy continuation tokens (+0.026 / +0.055 step-1 acceptance), but the drafters are worse on tokens of every type outside English (−0.195 / −0.426), in all 20 languages.

Not claimed: the design's timing is recorded in a private repository and is not externally verifiable; greedy decoding and verify-pass counts only; two built-in drafters. See README.md.
